allowed_transition: wait for the existing coordinator to pause only the executor parent during the final HJ child
wait for HJ COMPLETE_E200 and the explicit READY_FOR_INDEPENDENT_HNEK_IMPORT record
wait for a same-host COMPLETE_MATCHED_BASELINE_VERIFIED HNEK e200 source
run the existing no-overwrite import with require_paused=true
resume the same executor PID after an IMPORT_VERIFIED receipt
crash_recovery: If import completes before the watcher exits, a restart resumes from the verified receipt without copying again.
claim_boundary: This closes an orchestration idle-time gap only. It does not accept, compare, rank, or modify HNEK.
